modelRecommendation.rationale: This workflow mixes web inspection, report updates, and judgment-heavy trade summaries, so a stronger model is preferable to a cheap one.

schema.description: Human-readable source description for where the agent should find the current top profitable accounts on [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/).
schema.label: Leaderboard source

schema.description: Choose whether to keep following a fixed override list or refresh the top 5 dynamically from the leaderboard.
schema.label: Leader selection mode

schema.description: Optional wallet addresses or aliases to follow instead of the live leaderboard when the selection mode is `fixed_override`.
schema.label: Top account overrides

schema.description: Controls whether the agent only watches, prepares an order ticket for review, or follows automatically after you add an audited execution workflow.
schema.label: Execution mode

schema.description: Total capital you are willing to reserve for this strategy.
schema.label: Copy bankroll (USD)

schema.description: Absolute cap for any single copied trade.
schema.label: Max copy size per order (USD)

schema.description: Hard stop to prevent runaway activity on unusually busy days.
schema.label: Max copied orders per day

schema.description: Reject or flag any proposed copy trade if the market moved beyond this slippage allowance.
schema.label: Max slippage (bps)

schema.description: Start date for the two-month review window in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.
schema.label: Evaluation start date

schema.description: How long the strategy should run before the agent writes the formal review section.
schema.label: Evaluation window (days)

schema.description: Wallets to ignore even if they appear in the live leaderboard.
schema.label: Excluded wallets

schema.description: Free-form notes about sizing, special exclusions, or anything the monitor should keep in mind.
schema.label: Operator notes

description: Monitor the current top 5 profitable Polymarket accounts, surface fresh order activity, and measure copy-trading performance over a 60-day window.
name: Polymarket Leader Follower
